summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a definitive agreement to acquire Cyberhawk Holdings Limited, a global leader in critical infrastructure intelligence and drone-based inspection. The filing does not disclose exact financial terms, price per share, premium, or stake percentage. Ondas, the registrant and acquirer, issued a fact sheet and investor presentation alongside the press release. No board recommendation, advisor, deal mechanics, or regulatory timeline are provided. The acquisition enhances Ondas' dual-purpose platform with AI-enabled analytics. Key watch items include deal financing, regulatory approvals, and integration risks.
